title: Your Wellness Program Remains Underutilized … Now What?
abstract: Many organizations offer wellness programs; yet they are unfortunately underutilized by employees. For that reason, we address concerns around how to get employees to participate, and more importantly, how to get employees to sustain behavioral health changes. Specifically, we offer theoretically guided recommendations for implementing wellness program best practices. We make the case and provide examples to demonstrate that programs which fulfill psychological needs will benefit from greater participation and more sustained behavioral health changes. We also note that as an external motivator, financial incentives may encourage participation but likely do not facilitate sustained behavioral health changes. Again, a need-supportive wellness program is necessary. We hope practitioners find our illustrative examples useful as they think about their own wellness program design.
